controls.title: Permission bypass is observed
controls.rationale: Bypass mode removes most interactive safety checks and permits broad unattended configured capability.
controls.remediation: Remove the observed bypass mode or invocation flag and explicitly deny capabilities that must remain unavailable.

controls.title: Automatic permission mode is configured
controls.rationale: Automatic classification can permit broad unattended actions without per-action human approval.
controls.remediation: Use an interactive or deny-by-default permission mode and add narrowly scoped allow rules only where needed.

controls.title: Shell execution is unprompted
controls.rationale: Unprompted general shell execution can mutate files, invoke programs, and reach ambient host capabilities.
controls.remediation: Remove broad Bash allows and use deny, ask, or narrowly scoped command rules.

controls.title: File mutation is unprompted
controls.rationale: Unprompted writes can alter source, configuration, or other data in the configured path scope.
controls.remediation: Require approval for Edit-family tools or deny mutation outside narrowly required paths.

controls.title: Claude Code sandbox is absent or disabled
controls.rationale: Without the configured OS-enforced sandbox, Bash subprocesses lack this additional containment boundary.
controls.remediation: Set sandbox.enabled to true and verify runtime support separately.

controls.title: Unsandboxed retry is permitted
controls.rationale: The escape hatch can retry commands outside the configured sandbox boundary.

controls.title: Weaker nested sandbox isolation is enabled
controls.rationale: Weaker nested isolation reduces the strength of the configured subprocess boundary.
controls.remediation: Disable enableWeakerNestedSandbox unless a separately assessed environment requires it.

controls.title: Commands are excluded from sandboxing
controls.rationale: Excluded commands execute outside the configured sandbox boundary.
controls.remediation: Remove command exclusions or keep the list narrowly justified.

controls.title: Outbound capability lacks a configured destination boundary
controls.rationale: Configured outbound capability without a destination boundary can reach unbounded remote endpoints after its permission flow.
controls.remediation: Deny unused web tools and configure a narrow sandbox destination policy for Bash subprocesses.

controls.title: Executable hook surface is configured
controls.rationale: Command hooks can execute with the user's OS permissions when their lifecycle event occurs.
controls.remediation: Remove unnecessary command hooks and independently review required hook executables.

controls.title: MCP capability is configured
controls.rationale: Configured MCP servers can add external tool surfaces if they later connect and expose tools.
controls.remediation: Remove unused server definitions and constrain server selection and MCP tool permission rules.

controls.title: Unknown approval security field is not evaluated
controls.rationale: An unmodelled approval field can change posture in a way Kaapi cannot evaluate.
controls.remediation: Review the field against current Claude Code documentation and update Kaapi before relying on a clean posture.

controls.title: Unknown permission security field is not evaluated
controls.rationale: An unmodelled permission field can change resolved tool capability.
controls.remediation: Review the field and update Kaapi's permission model before relying on a clean posture.

controls.title: Unknown sandbox security field is not evaluated
controls.rationale: An unmodelled sandbox field can change the subprocess boundary.
controls.remediation: Review the field and update Kaapi's sandbox model before relying on a clean posture.

controls.title: Unknown network security field is not evaluated
controls.rationale: An unmodelled network field can change configured destination boundaries or exceptions.
controls.remediation: Review the field and update Kaapi's network model before relying on a clean posture.

controls.title: Unknown hook security field is not evaluated
controls.rationale: An unmodelled hook field can change executable lifecycle behavior.
controls.remediation: Review the field and update Kaapi's hook model before relying on a clean posture.

controls.title: Unknown MCP security field is not evaluated
controls.rationale: An unmodelled MCP field can change server selection or tool exposure semantics.
controls.remediation: Review the field and update Kaapi's MCP model before relying on a clean posture.
